test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 4 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 9 (1)/(3) hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pump to fill tank = 4 hrs

Time taken with leakage = 9¹/₃ hrs = 28/3 hrs

**Formula used:**

Work rates are added/subtracted.

LCM method is used for efficiency.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 4 and 28/3 = 28

Let total work = 28 units

Pump’s 1 hr work = 28 ÷ 4 = 7 units

Net 1 hr work (pump + leak) = 28 ÷ (28/3) = 3 units

⇒ Leak’s 1 hr work = 7 - 3 = 4 units (emptying)

Time taken by leak alone = 28 ÷ 4 = 7 hrs

**∴ Leak will empty the tank in 7 hours.**
